mockmob-original-stimulus-diverse-da3726.text: In a fictional school event, the organiser first asked each group how many chairs it needed. After collecting the replies, she prepared a seating list. Volunteers then placed the chairs according to that completed list. When the arrangement was ready, the organiser checked it against the groups' replies. The account explicitly orders those four stages of this particular event.

mockmob-original-stimulus-diverse-fb5bfb.text: In this fictional account, Ravi received a sealed parcel addressed to his class. Before opening it, he checked the address against the class's order receipt. Once he had confirmed the match, he opened the parcel and counted the notebooks inside. Finally, he recorded the count on the receipt and placed the notebooks in the cupboard. These events occurred in that stated order.

mockmob-original-stimulus-diverse-d5b819.text: Rain had washed the chalk game from the lane. The children arrived with fresh chalk and began drawing again. One child remembered the old squares as longer; another insisted that the turning square had been on the left. They argued until a passing neighbour asked whether the new game had to reproduce the old one. After a moment, they drew a wider turning square in the middle. Their feet soon covered the fresh lines with pale dust. From her doorway, the neighbour could no longer tell which marks belonged to yesterday and which belonged to the game they had just invented.
